cham.de_bai: In the “Skills” section, insert a endnote to the right of the heading. Enter the endnote text “Includes digital and printed files.”.

cham.de_bai: In the “Fill Material” section, convert the tab-delimited text that starts with “Phase” to a two-column table. Accept the default AutoFit behavior.

du_an.mo_ta: Mở file De03_P3_Robotics.docx và làm lần lượt các yêu cầu bên dưới (đề tiếng Anh như thi thật). File phụ (ảnh, dữ liệu, 3D Models) nằm cùng thư mục bài làm.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Inspect the document and remove all headers, footers, and watermarks that are found. Do not remove any other information.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) File > Info > Check for Issues > Inspect Document > Inspect.  2) Tại mục Headers, Footers, and Watermarks bấm Remove All.  3) Không xoá các mục khác. Close.

cham.de_bai: Inspect the document and remove all headers, footers, and watermarks that are found. Do not remove any other information.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: In the “Safety” section, change the line spacing of the two paragraphs after the heading to exactly 18 pt.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn hai đoạn văn dưới tiêu đề.  2) Home > Paragraph dialog (mũi tên nhỏ) > Line spacing: Exactly; At: 18 pt > OK.

cham.de_bai: In the “Safety” section, change the line spacing of the two paragraphs after the heading to exactly 18 pt.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: In the “Game Rules” section, add a new row to the bottom of the table. Enter “Sample”, “North”, and “10” in the new row.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Đặt con trỏ ở ô cuối cùng của bảng.  2) Table Layout > Insert Below (hoặc nhấn Tab ở ô cuối).  3) Nhập lần lượt: Sample | North | 10.

cham.de_bai: In the “Game Rules” section, add a new row to the bottom of the table. Enter “Sample”, “North”, and “10” in the new row.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Format the heading “Competition Overview” so that it always appears on the same page as the paragraph that follows it and all lines of the heading are kept together.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Đặt con trỏ trong tiêu đề.  2) Home > Paragraph dialog > tab Line and Page Breaks.  3) Tích Keep with next và Keep lines together > OK.

cham.de_bai: Format the heading “Competition Overview” so that it always appears on the same page as the paragraph that follows it and all lines of the heading are kept together.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: In the “Robot Requirements” section, change the bullet points to custom ones. Use the four-diamond symbol from the Wingdings font and character code “118”.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn toàn bộ danh sách bullet.  2) Home > mũi tên Bullets > Define New Bullet > Symbol.  3) Font: Wingdings; Character code: 118 > OK > OK.

cham.de_bai: In the “Robot Requirements” section, change the bullet points to custom ones. Use the four-diamond symbol from the Wingdings font and character code “118”.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: In the SmartArt graphic in the “Safety” section, change the text “Program” to “Program and Review”.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn SmartArt > SmartArt Design > Text Pane.  2) Sửa dòng "Program" thành "Program and Review".

cham.de_bai: In the SmartArt graphic in the “Safety” section, change the text “Program” to “Program and Review”.

cham.de_bai: Set the paragraph spacing for the entire document to Double.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Use a Word feature to replace all instances of “Habitat Homes Vietnam” with “HHV Group”.

cham.de_bai: Use a Word feature to replace all instances of “Habitat Homes Vietnam” with “HHV Group”.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Change the number format of all footnotes in the document to i, ii, iii, ….
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) References > hộp thoại Footnote and Endnote (mũi tên nhỏ).  2) Footnotes; Number format: i, ii, iii, …; Apply changes to: Whole document > Apply.

cham.de_bai: Change the number format of all footnotes in the document to i, ii, iii, ….

cham.de_bai: In the “How to Volunteer” section, insert a caption below the table. Use the Table label and the caption text “: Housing data”.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: In the “Stories from Families” section, set the spacing before the two paragraphs after the heading to 12 pt and the spacing after to 12 pt.

cham.de_bai: In the “Stories from Families” section, set the spacing before the two paragraphs after the heading to 12 pt and the spacing after to 12 pt.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: In the file properties, change the Title property to “Clean City Initiative Overview”.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) File > Info > Properties.  2) Ô Title: xoá nội dung cũ, nhập "Clean City Initiative Overview".

cham.de_bai: Apply the Intense Quote style to the paragraph that starts with “Clean City Initiative gives free compost …”.

cham.de_bai: In the “Get Involved” section, in the blank paragraph, use the 3D Models feature to insert the Cube model from the 3D Models folder. Position the model In Line with Text.

cham.de_bai: Save a copy of the document as a Word template named “Clean” that does not support macros. Save the template in the Documents folder.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Restrict editing of the document so that users can only insert comments. Start enforcing protection without a password.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Review > Restrict Editing.  2) Editing restrictions: tích Allow only this type of editing in the document > chọn Comments.  3) Yes, Start Enforcing Protection > để trống hai ô mật khẩu > OK.

cham.de_bai: Restrict editing of the document so that users can only insert comments. Start enforcing protection without a password.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Add the alt text title “Scuba table” to the table in the “Marine Life” section.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: In the blank paragraph after the "List of Tables" heading, insert a table of figures that references the Table captions. Use the Formal format.

cham.de_bai: In the blank paragraph after the "List of Tables" heading, insert a table of figures that references the Table captions. Use the Formal format.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Modify the Heading 1 style so that it uses 18 pt, bold, Orange, Accent 2, Darker 25% font color. Apply the changes to this document only.

cham.de_bai: Modify the Heading 1 style so that it uses 18 pt, bold, Orange, Accent 2, Darker 25% font color. Apply the changes to this document only.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Encrypt the document by using the password “MOSexpert”.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) File > Info > Protect Document > Encrypt with Password.  2) Nhập MOSexpert > OK > nhập lại MOSexpert > OK.

cham.de_bai: Encrypt the document by using the password “MOSexpert”.
